profile_text.body:
Wayground, formerly Quizizz, describes itself as a teacher AI and resources platform. According to its site, it offers standards-aligned resources intended to help teachers differentiate instruction with AI and track student progress, with tools for building activities, delivering them to students, and analyzing results in one place. The company describes its AI features as bite-sized and approachable for everyday use, citing examples such as translating a homework page, changing a reading level, or adding a real-world scenario. It also says it provides academic integrity tools including lockdown modes, anti-cheating alerts, and academic integrity reports.

The product tracked under the company is Quizizz, listed in the Education and Research AI category. Its recorded uses are quizzes, lessons, and AI generation, aimed at teachers and students. Students join by code with a name and no account is required. Pricing is recorded as a free Starter plan whose library is limited to 20 resources from January 1, 2026, an individual paid plan at about $10 per month, and school plans by contract. The company was renamed Wayground in June 2025. No lawsuits, MCP servers, or other filings are recorded.
